assessment.token_counting_caveat: All 54 observed proxy CONNECT attempts to api.anthropic.com:443 were rejected before TLS; these CLI context counts must be treated as offline estimates, not successful remote token counts, invoices or measured savings. The proxy is not a host network sandbox. apiUsage is null and message token counts are zero in both sessions.
assessment.preparation_failure: First audit redundantly passed sleep to an image whose entrypoint already was /bin/sleep; the container exited before SDK startup. Cleanup removed it; a case-sensitive missing-object assertion then failed. Original script, logs and a separate terminal assessment are retained. The second attempt fixes both errors.
assessment.next_decision: Hold promotion. This connection does not support a missing/deferred-tool or missing-server-instruction diagnosis. No additional schema rewrite or paid exact-name lookup is justified. Require a real source-linked cross-file maintenance task, useful voluntary use and a verifiable edit/test outcome before a new efficacy protocol. Preserve earlier frozen results and all quality/time/usage/reuse gates.

upstream_review.finding: The documented MCP-status and context-usage controls inspect the session. Context breakdown makes token-count API requests outside the message stream; token counting is unbilled on the Anthropic API. These calls are not an inference task.

Current upstream describes semantic navigation, symbolic edits and rename. Moving, inlining and deletion propagation are backend-dependent; several refactorings are JetBrains-only. This differs from CodeNib's read-only source/navigation surface.

The vendor's methodology has the agent choose examples and evaluate both toolsets itself across navigation, editing, refactoring, reliability and workflow effects. This is qualitative workload guidance, not an independently graded CodeNib comparison or a replacement for the existing pilot gates.

The prompt assumes correct tool use and excludes misuse failures. Keep CodeNib's existing failures, retries, initialization and update costs in the unchanged full-workflow objective; do not adopt that exclusion after observing failures.

assessment.upstream_scope: Current upstream documentation was reviewed, not executed. Frozen competitor binaries, source, cohorts and scores were not updated or rescored. No new refactoring product surface is authorized by this review alone.

format: Each UTF-8 record stores gzip_base64. Decode base64, verify gzip_sha256, gunzip, then verify bytes and sha256. No wheel binary or native vendor system-prompt text is published.
